retainedIndependentSummary: Viewed all four supplied PNGs, including the native 128px portrait and the native 1x / nearest 3x panels on light, dark and checker backgrounds. The large silver-backed purple spider fills its standing cell well. Nine separate red eye clusters, four leg chains on each side and two attached pale fangs are readable; overlapping roots make the far legs less immediately countable at 1x. Broad upper-left highlights and lower-right slate shadows give the carapace volume, with darker purple joints separating the body segments. No obvious broken body connection, accidental interior transparency or missing silhouette outline is visible. Windup lowers the head and folds the front legs; move changes the supporting legs; attack projects the head and opens the connected jaws toward the right; recover retracts them. The shell remains nearly stationary, so dash force depends partly on runtime movement. Near supporting feet stay at the lower baseline, while raised limbs read as intentional. Skill preparation has a purple nucleus between the fangs, contact sends two web branches from that mouth region, and recovery closes the jaws with three residual droplets. Poison crouches with bent legs and bubbles; stun droops the head and closes the eyes with stars; sleep folds the limbs beneath a lower body, distinct from the flatter splayed death pose. These are visible pose changes rather than simple recolors. Idle and paired status changes are subtle. Static previews do not establish animation timing, sliding, battle contact, boss scale against allies, palette compliance or literal-grid authorship. This recommendation is independent visual review, not a user selection.
